player_prompt.intro:
Wakapinda uye Player {player_id} muChopsticks. Pamusoro pedu wekutanga, chagua chimwe chino:
  + Kuvambisa:  '[attack M O]'  apo M=ruko rako (0 kana 1), O=ruko rwevamwe (0 kana 1).
    - Ruko rwevamwe runokwira kwekutamba kwa ruko rako; kana rive zvikuru kulika 5, ruyafuka 0.
  + Kugova:   '[split L R]'  kugova utsvina hwe rupande rwenyu kuL na R (L+R = wako wose).
Lingana na chidimbu chimwe chino cha kudzimba.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Kupatsanurwa kunofanira kuchinja kugoverwa kwemaoko ako.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kusasuka kwako hakusiwi. Utumie “[attack M O]” kana “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} anorwisa ruoko rwaP{opp_id} {opp_idx}: rinobva pa {opp_val} richienda ku {new_val}.

outcome.win: Maoko omuvengi ose ari maviri akafa.
